title: The Martyr Procession Is Prepared Like a Wedding

blocks.text: Once the volunteers are chosen, the Singhs begin to prepare as if for both battle and ceremony. Ever ready were they to make a sacrifice, so they arm themselves carefully, cleanse their minds through prayer, and transform their readiness for death into a disciplined liturgy of the Panth.

The rites are explicitly devotional. Gurbani did they recite from Sri Guru Granth Sahib, they complete five verses of Anand Sahib, and sacred food is distributed in a mood that resembles both a congregation and a wedding feast arranged for a blessed occasion.

Gurbakhsh Singh is then dressed and honored as the bridegroom of martyrdom. From the holy Darbar Sahib was he presented a garland, while perfume, weapons, and song combine to send him forth with joy rather than despair.
